1.title: 🚣 Beginner kayak camp — Registration is open! Join us on the waters of Algiers Bay for a full introduction guided by our certified instructors.

2.title: 🏄 Weekend promotion — 20% off all paddle rentals! Enjoy the Mediterranean at a lower price. Offer valid Friday, Saturday and Sunday.

3.title: 🏊 Advanced swimming workshop — Our national coach Karim Benamara will lead an intensive technical improvement session. Very limited spots, book quickly!

4.title: ⛵ Inter-club sailing championship — The Nautical Center is organizing its annual competition in Sidi Fredj Bay. Teams of 3 to 5 members. Register before April 10.

5.title: 👦 Summer Youth Program 2026 — This summer, give your children (ages 8 to 14) an unforgettable nautical adventure on the Algerian coast. Swimming, kayaking, sailing and diving are all on the program!

6.title: 🛟 Aquatic Safety Certification — Official training recognized by the Algerian Swimming Federation. Only 12 spots available. Ideal for instructors and activity leaders.

7.title: 🧘 Sunset paddle yoga — A unique experience facing the Mediterranean. Every Friday evening at 6 PM at Tipaza harbor. Beginner level welcome, mats provided.

8.title: ⚓ Our new fleet has arrived! 8 sea kayaks, 4 Optimist sailboats and 6 brand-new paddles have just joined our center. Come try them this week!

9.title: 🤝 Bring a friend, let them sail for free! For any session booking this week, your guest gets a free spot. Share the passion of the sea!

10.title: 🏆 End-of-season gala — Join us for our center's award night. Trophies, traditional Algerian buffet and live music are all on the schedule. Members and families are welcome.
